name: LQS - Lead: resolve identity
description: Stateful. In: channel, external_id, display_name, market_code. Out: { ok, lead_id, conversation_id, market_id, deal_type, language, bot_muted }. Finds the lead identity or creates lead + identity + conversation, and reuses the lead's active conversation (creating one if the last is closed).

parameters.query: with m as (select id, default_language from lqs.markets where code = $4 and active limit 1), existing as (select li.lead_id from lqs.lead_identities li where li.channel = $1 and li.external_id = $2), new_lead as (insert into lqs.leads (market_id, full_name, source, status) select m.id, nullif($3, ''), $1, 'new' from m where not exists (select 1 from existing) returning id), lead_row as (select lead_id as id from existing union all select id from new_lead), new_identity as (insert into lqs.lead_identities (lead_id, channel, external_id, display_name) select lead_row.id, $1, $2, nullif($3, '') from lead_row where not exists (select 1 from existing) on conflict (channel, external_id) do nothing returning lead_id), existing_conv as (select c.* from lqs.conversations c, lead_row where c.lead_id = lead_row.id and c.status <> 'closed' order by c.created_at desc limit 1), new_conv as (insert into lqs.conversations (lead_id, market_id, deal_type, channel, status) select lead_row.id, m.id, 'offplan', $1, 'active' from lead_row, m where not exists (select 1 from existing_conv) returning *), conv as (select * from existing_conv union all select * from new_conv) select true as ok, conv.lead_id as lead_id, conv.id as conversation_id, conv.market_id as market_id, conv.deal_type as deal_type, coalesce(conv.language, m.default_language) as language, conv.bot_muted as bot_muted from conv, m;
